summary: GET /open/forms/{form}/submissions/export/status/{jobId} (behind auth.multi) now (a) is reachable with personal API tokens (added to sanctum-routes whitelist) but only if the token has forms-read, and (b) returns 404 unless the export job belongs to the requested form, closing a hole where any user who could view one form could read another form's export status, including its download file_url, given the job UUID. API docs/openapi corrected to the real path and fields.

statements.why: Route is inside auth.multi group (api/routes/api.php:100,264); controller keeps authorize('view',$form) and adds forms-read token check and form_id match (FormSubmissionController.php:124-133). Change tightens security.

statements.text: • The open form submissions export statu part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what it does differently. /open/forms/[form]/submissions/export/status/[jobId]

statements.why: Adds a changelog entry for the export-status path/fields fix and the token permission check; not explained.
Fixes documented path (/export/status/{job_id}) and response fields.
Corrects the documented status path and response fields; not explained.
Changes the example job_id to a UUID; trivial doc fix.

misses.what: Security fix not mentioned: previously a logged-in user with access to any form could poll another form's export job (getting its progress and the export file download link) by putting that job id under their own form; now such requests get 404.
Personal API tokens can now check export status (previously blocked with 404), but only tokens with the forms-read permission; others get 403.
Public API docs were pointing to a wrong URL for export status (returned 404) and listed wrong fields; now fixed, with a changelog entry. The card lists the doc files but doesn't say this.
